title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Drawing Board. Keep it, take the canon, or re-roll.

options.label: Drawing Board
options.lineage: engineering drawings, blueprints, and revision-controlled shop documentation
options.thesis: The site as the machine drawing of itself: dimensioned, toleranced, stamped — proof over promise.
options.viewport: A drawing sheet fills the first viewport: JOBE sits in the title block, the headline is dimensioned with arrows and callouts, the CTA is a stamped plate, and the revision block reads REV 02 — PRODUCTION READY.
options.risk: Can read cold or gimmicky if the linework and type are given no warmth; the drawing must stay a working document, never decoration.

canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
